# Calendar

> Date selection grid built on react-day-picker and themed through tokens.

This file matches the installed `calendar` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version.

## Install

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/calendar.json
```

With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/calendar.md`.

## npm dependencies

- `react-day-picker@^10.0.2`

## Registry dependencies

- `core`

## Exports

- `@/components/control-ui/knob-contracts/calendar-knobs`: `calendarKnobs`, types `CalendarKnobStyle`
- `@/components/control-ui/ui/calendar`: `Calendar`, types `CalendarProps`

## Composition

### Date selection

```tsx
<Calendar />
```

## Usage

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import type { DateRange } from "react-day-picker";
import { Calendar } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/calendar";
import { Text } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/typography";

export function PrimitiveCalendarExample() {
  const [date, setDate] = useState<Date | undefined>(new Date(2026, 6, 6));
  const [range, setRange] = useState<DateRange | undefined>({ from: new Date(2026, 6, 9), to: new Date(2026, 6, 15) });
  const [birthday, setBirthday] = useState<Date | undefined>(new Date(1994, 2, 18));

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-8 sm:flex-row sm:items-start">
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
        <Calendar mode="single" selected={date} onSelect={setDate} defaultMonth={date} />
        <Text size="caption" tone="muted" className="mx-1">
          {date ? new Intl.DateTimeFormat(undefined, { dateStyle: "full" }).format(date) : "No date selected"}
        </Text>
      </div>
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
        <Calendar mode="range" selected={range} onSelect={setRange} defaultMonth={range?.from} />
        <Text size="caption" tone="muted" className="mx-1">
          Pick a start day, then an end day
        </Text>
      </div>
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
        <Calendar
          mode="single"
          selected={birthday}
          onSelect={setBirthday}
          defaultMonth={birthday}
          captionLayout="dropdown"
          startMonth={new Date(1940, 0)}
          endMonth={new Date(2026, 11)}
          showWeekNumber
        />
        <Text size="caption" tone="muted" className="mx-1">
          Month and year dropdowns, with week numbers
        </Text>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Anatomy

Scopes, their parts, and the state attributes each part carries. Selector pattern: `[data-skin="{skin}"] :where([data-slot="{part}"][data-control-family="{family}"])`.

- `calendar`
  - `caption-label`
  - `chevron`: `data-icon-dir` (`inline`)
  - `day`: `data-range-end`, `data-range-middle`, `data-range-start`, `data-selected-single`, `data-today`
  - `day-cell`: `data-weekend`
  - `dropdown`: `data-disabled`, `data-focus-ring` (`within`)
  - `dropdown-label`
  - `dropdown-select`
  - `dropdowns`
  - `month`
  - `month-caption`
  - `month-grid`
  - `months`
  - `nav`
  - `nav-button`
  - `root`
  - `week-number`
  - `week-number-header`
  - `weekday`
